triggers.function_source:
begin
 if tg_op='DELETE' or new.id<>old.id or new.agent_id<>old.agent_id or new.token_hash<>old.token_hash or new.hint<>old.hint
  or new.created_at<>old.created_at or new.expires_at is distinct from old.expires_at
  or(old.revoked_at is not null and new.revoked_at is distinct from old.revoked_at) then
  raise exception 'erp_access_history_immutable' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 return new;
end

triggers.function_source:
begin
 if tg_op<>'UPDATE' or new.singleton is distinct from old.singleton or new.version<>old.version+1 or new.allow_negative=old.allow_negative
  or new.command_id is null or new.command_id is not distinct from old.command_id or new.updated_by is null or new.updated_at is null
  or not exists(select 1 from erp_stock.policy_command c where c.id=new.command_id and c.to_version=new.version and c.to_allow=new.allow_negative and c.actor=new.updated_by) then
  raise exception 'erp_stock_policy_immutable' using errcode='40001';end if;
 return new;
end

triggers.function_source:
begin
 if tg_op='DELETE' then raise exception 'erp_stock_reservation_immutable' using errcode='40001';end if;
 if old.state<>'active' or new.state not in('released','consumed') or new.version<>2
  or(to_jsonb(new)-array['state','version','closed_by','closed_at','close_reason','close_command_id','consumed_command_id'])
    is distinct from(to_jsonb(old)-array['state','version','closed_by','closed_at','close_reason','close_command_id','consumed_command_id']) then
  raise exception 'erp_stock_reservation_immutable' using errcode='40001';end if;return new;
end
